round_started.title: Round {round}
round_started.body: A new round begins. Look at the boss and plan your moves together.

phase_planning.title: Phase 1 · Planning
body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] is planning its attacks.
The attack against each of you is shown at your seat :damage:.

phase_action.title: Phase 3 · Actions
body: Reveal your curses now, if you have any.
Each hero has [b]3 turns[/b] with one action each, clockwise, starting with [player]{player}[/player].
Heroes with panic :panic: play their hand cards at random, and discard 1 panic token after each.
Show your card to the camera when it is your turn.

boss_hits_with_tokens.title: Phase 4 · Attack
body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] hits [player]{player}[/player] for [damage]{damage} damage[/damage] :damage:.
[player]{player}[/player] also takes [poison]{tokens}[/poison].

phase_attack_blocked.title: Phase 4 · Attack
phase_attack_blocked.body: You blocked everything! [boss]{boss}[/boss] hits nobody this round.

phase_status.title: Phase 5 · Status
body: Poison :poison:: lose [damage]1 health[/damage] :health: per poison token.
Fire :fire:: draw [b]1[/b] :card: per fire token. For each card: remove it for the rest of the fight, [i]or[/i] discard it and lose [damage]2 health[/damage] :health:.

phase_discard.title: Phase 6 · Discard
body: Move the cards from your play area to your discard pile.
Discard down to your hand limit. You may discard more.

phase_draw.title: Phase 7 · Draw
body: Draw up to your hand limit :card:.
Paralysis :paralysis:: your hand limit is [damage]1 lower[/damage] per paralysis token.

support_without_attack.title: No effect
support_without_attack.body: A support only works after a [b]{kind}[/b] attack this round. [player]{player}[/player]'s support does nothing.

heal.body: [player]{player}[/player] heals [heal]{amount} health[/heal] :health:, but not above their starting health.

empowered.body: Until the end of the round, every {kind} of [player]{player}[/player] gets [heal]+{bonus}[/heal].

remove_tokens.body: [player]{player}[/player] removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] of their own tokens.

mirefang_bite.title: Venomous Bite
mirefang_bite.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] licks its lips: its attack on [player]{player}[/player] is poisonous :poison:.

defeat.title: Defeat
defeat.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] has won this time. Rest, and try again!

prompt_choose_starter.body: Who starts this round? [b]Tap a hero.[/b]

prompt_tied_target.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] cannot decide. [b]Tap the hero it targets.[/b]

prompt_free_play_who.body: [player]{player}[/player] lets another hero play a card for free. [b]Tap who.[/b]

prompt_lucky_charm.body: [player]{player}[/player], show the [b]top card of your draw pile[/b] :card:.

notice_played_already.body: This card is already in play this round.

notice_not_your_card.body: This is not a card of [player]{player}[/player].

notice_used_up.body: [player]{player}[/player] has used this up in this fight.

notice_removed.body: This card is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

take_from_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes [b]{count}[/b] :card: of their choice from their draw pile.

card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player], put this card back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

attack_effects_removed.body: The attack against [player]{player}[/player] loses its extra effect.

attack_redirected.body: [player]{player}[/player] steps in front of [player]{other}[/player]: the attack of [damage]{damage}[/damage] :damage: now hits [player]{player}[/player].

ward_placed.body: [player]{player}[/player] places [b]{card}[/b] next to their hero card. It can prevent one of the boss's @-abilities against [player]{player}[/player].

ward_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] prevents the boss's next @-ability up to [b]{strength}[/b].

shield_breaker.body: Shield destroyed! [boss]{boss}[/boss] loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] at once.

prompt_if_healthy.body: Does [player]{player}[/player] now have [b]{health} health[/b] :health: or more?

prompt_chosen_hero.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] the card of [player]{player}[/player] is for.

prompt_remove_tokens_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] tokens.

prompt_redirect_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] whose attack [player]{player}[/player] takes on.

prompt_use_ward.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] uses an @-ability against [player]{player}[/player]. Discard [b]{card}[/b] to prevent it?

prompt_robot_working.body: Does the battle robot of [player]{player}[/player] still work?

prompt_top_card_or_item.body: [player]{player}[/player], play the [b]top card of your deck[/b] :card: or use Grandpa's Glass Eye.

prompt_attack_or_item.body: [player]{player}[/player], play a hand card with an [b]attack[/b] :card: or use the Water Skin.

notice_still_in_play.body: This card still lies next to the hero card of [player]{player}[/player].

notice_not_here.body: This item cannot be used here.

prompt_search_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player], search your [b]draw pile[/b] for a card and show it :card:.

searched_card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player] shuffles their draw pile and puts [b]{card}[/b] back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

prompt_discard_or_top.body: [player]{player}[/player], show a card from your [b]discard pile[/b] or the [b]top card of your draw pile[/b] :card:.

played_card_removed.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts [b]{card}[/b] back in the box: it is out of the game for the rest of the fight.

toxin_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player]: from now on, each [poison]poison token[/poison] :poison: of the boss costs it [damage]{damage} health[/damage] more at the end of the round.

nothing_to_repeat.body: No card with an attack has been played yet, so nothing takes effect again.

attack_delayed.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] only goes off at the start of their first turn next round.

prompt_halve_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] whose attack is halved.

attack_halved.body: The attack against [player]{player}[/player] is halved to [damage]{damage}[/damage] :damage: and loses its extra effect.

remove_curse.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts 1 active curse of any hero on the curse discard pile.

card_to_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] puts [b]{count}[/b] other card from their hand on top of their draw pile :card:.

prompt_play_top_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who plays the top [b]{count}[/b] cards of their draw pile.

boss_poison.body: The poison works! [boss]{boss}[/boss] has [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison: and loses [damage]{damage} health[/damage] :health:.

example_magic_potion.title: Magic Potion
example_magic_potion.body: Choose a player to gain [heal]{health} health points[/heal] :health:.

example_reminder.body: [i]Remember:[/i] poisoned heroes lose [damage]1[/damage] :health: at the end of each round.

prompt_lower_shield.body: [player]{player}[/player], choose the shield that goes down by [damage]{amount}[/damage].

shield_lowered.body: The {kind} shield of [boss]{boss}[/boss] goes down by [damage]{amount}[/damage].

no_shield_to_lower.body: [boss]{boss}[/boss] has no shield left: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] does nothing.

prompt_poison_on_attack_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b]: whenever a boss attack of [damage]{threshold}[/damage] or more strikes them, the boss gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.

poison_on_attack_ready.body: [b]{card}[/b]: until the end of the fight, the boss gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison: whenever it attacks [player]{player}[/player] with [damage]{threshold}[/damage] or more.

poison_on_attack.body: [b]{card}[/b] strikes back: [boss]{boss}[/boss] attacks [player]{player}[/player] and gets [poison]{poison} poison[/poison] :poison:.

attacks_weakened_next_round.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player]: next round, every attack of the boss is [heal]{amount}[/heal] lower.

attacks_weakened.body: [b]{card}[/b] of [player]{player}[/player] takes effect: every attack of the boss is [heal]{amount}[/heal] lower.

remove_tokens_everyone.body: Each hero removes up to [heal]{count}[/heal] of their tokens.

form_thorn.title: Thorn Form
form_thorn.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes the Thorn Form: their attacks and supports get [heal]+1[/heal].

form_blossom.title: Blossom Form
form_blossom.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes the Blossom Form: each time their attacks or supports cost the boss health, they heal [heal]3 health[/heal] :health:.

form_bark.title: Bark Form
form_bark.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes the Bark Form: their protection :shield: gets [heal]+1[/heal].

transfer_health.body: [player]{player}[/player] may give as much of their health :health: as they like to [b]exactly one[/b] other hero.

card_back_to_pile.body: [player]{player}[/player] does not discard [b]{card}[/b], but shuffles it back into their draw pile :card:.

prompt_redraw_hand_who.body: [b]Tap the hero[/b] who discards any number of hand cards and then draws up to their hand limit.

redraw_hand.body: [player]{player}[/player] discards as many hand cards as they like, then draws up to their hand limit :card:.

discard_random.body: [player]{player}[/player] discards [b]{count}[/b] random card from their hand, if they have one :card:.

shields_lowered.body: Every shield of [boss]{boss}[/boss] goes down by [damage]{amount}[/damage], without its effect.

threat_lowers_on_attack.body: Each time [player]{player}[/player] plays an attack this round, the boss's attack against them goes down by [heal]{amount}[/heal].

threat_lowered.body: The attack of [boss]{boss}[/boss] against [player]{player}[/player] goes down by [heal]{amount}[/heal].

remove_tokens_group.body: Together you remove up to [heal]{count}[/heal] tokens, from whoever you like.

look_at_top_everyone.body: Each hero looks at the top [b]{look}[/b] :card: of their draw pile, takes [b]{take}[/b] of them into their hand and puts the other [b]{back}[/b] back in any order.

search_to_hand.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes [b]{count}[/b] :card: of their choice from their draw pile into their hand and shuffles the pile.

take_token.body: [player]{player}[/player] takes [damage]{count}[/damage] status token of their choice from the supply.

draw_and_play.body: [player]{player}[/player] draws [b]{draw}[/b] :card:, plays [b]{play}[/b] of them at once and discards the other [b]{discard}[/b].

prompt_play_drawn.body: [player]{player}[/player], show one of the [b]cards you just drew[/b] :card:.

tear_placed.body: [player]{player}[/player] places [b]{card}[/b] next to their hero card. When a hero would lose health, from anything, you may discard it to prevent that: keep track of it on the table.

draw_and_return_everyone.body: Each hero draws [b]{draw}[/b] :card:, then puts [b]{back}[/b] of their hand cards face down on their draw pile.

next_cards_boosted.body: On the next [b]{cards}[/b] :card: played, by anyone, every attack and support is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

random_token.body: Chosen at random: [player]{player}[/player] takes a status token, [poison]{tokens}[/poison].

totem_attack.title: {card}
body: Give [player]{player}[/player] the totem token :totem:.
Until the end of the round, every attack of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

totem_support.title: {card}
body: Give [player]{player}[/player] the totem token :totem:.
Until the end of the round, every support of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

totem_protection.title: {card}
body: Give [player]{player}[/player] the totem token :totem:.
Until the end of the round, every protection :shield: of [player]{player}[/player] is [heal]{bonus}[/heal] higher.

totem_lightning.title: {card}
body: Give [player]{player}[/player] the totem token :totem:.
Until the end of the round, [player]{player}[/player] may remove [heal]{count}[/heal] of their status tokens for each lightning :lightning: they play.

tokens_per_lightning.body: Until the end of the round, [player]{player}[/player] may remove [heal]{count}[/heal] of their status tokens for each lightning :lightning: they play.

totems_returned.title: Totems
totems_returned.body: The round is over. Give back the totem tokens :totem:: [player]{players}[/player].
